messages:
Lina: quick accessibility follow-up from the dashboard heatmap review. during the usability session a colorblind participant couldn't differentiate the blue/green cells reliably. also legend relies solely on color swatches which isn't enough.
Omar: thanks for flagging — which palette are we using now? and which chart lib?
Lina: we use our default sequential palette (teal -> blue) in the heatmap, rendered via SVG rects in the Viz kit. chart lib: internal wrapper over d3.
Priya: teal/blue is a common fail for deuteranopia. options: 1) add texture/pattern fills in addition to color, 2) use colorblind-safe palette (ColorBrewer 8-class colorblind-safe), or 3) provide a mode toggle (Color + Pattern) in settings.
Duncan: product note: prefer not to clutter settings for now. small change with big impact is ideal. what's minimal & maintainable?
Omar: minimal approach: keep color palette but add subtle SVG patterns for distinct value buckets (diagonal hatch, dots, crosshatch). patterns can be optional via a feature flag and are cheap to render in SVG defs. snippet:
```
<defs>
  <pattern id="p-dots" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="6" height="6">
    <circle cx="1" cy="1" r="1" fill="currentColor" />
  </pattern>
  <pattern id="p-hatch" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="6" height="6">
    <path d="M0,6 L6,0" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" />
  </pattern>
</defs>
<rect fill="url(#p-hatch)" />
```
Use currentColor so pattern color matches theme tokens.
Priya: patterns help but also need accessible legend & text alternatives. legend items should include both color swatch and pattern preview and be keyboard-focusable with an explicit aria-label (e.g., `aria-label="Severity: high (pattern: crosshatch)"`). Also add `role="list"`/`role="listitem"` for screen readers.
Lina: good. any thoughts about annotating each cell for SR users? announcing every cell would be noisy.
Priya: for dense grids, don't announce each cell by default. prefer these strategies:
3 Provide an aggregated summary via a live region when filters change (e.g., "Showing heatmap for last 7 days. 12 high, 20 medium, 8 low").
3 Make individual cells focusable via keyboard (tab/arrow navigation) but announce concise content on focus: "Rank: 3, Value: 12%". Keep the cell aria-label short.
3 Expose a table view toggle (visually-hidden table) for screen reader users who prefer linearized data. a11y patterns often include a "View as table" control.
Omar: implementing focusable cells is doable: give each rect tabindex="-1" and manage roving focus via arrow keys inside the grid; also provide `aria-roledescription="heatmap cell"` and `aria-label` describing bucket and value.
Duncan: product question: will patterns and legends confuse sighted users? could clutter.
Lina: keep patterns subtle and provide an opt-out via settings. default: enable pattern overlay only when user has OS-level colorblind preference? hmm not reliable. better: enable pattern mode for compact mode where color differences are critical (like severity heatmaps), otherwise graceful fallback.
Priya: we can detect prefers-reduced-color-scheme? not helpful. I'd suggest feature flag + analytics to measure usage then consider default. Meanwhile make legend & toggles discoverable: add a small "Legend" button that opens a tooltip/panel describing color & pattern semantics with keyboard access.
Omar: engineering plan:
1) add SVG pattern defs and apply pattern overlay for each bucket class using CSS variables for pattern color and opacity.
2) update legend component to render swatch + pattern preview and make each legend item keyboard focusable with aria-pressed toggles to hide/show that bucket (nice bonus).
3) add keyboard navigation for cells (roving tabindex) and concise aria-labels.
4) add a hidden table export/toggle for SR power users.
Priya: tests:
3 unit: verify legend items have aria-labels, patterns render, and cells have tabindex and aria-label.
3 integration: keyboard navigation across heatmap cells moves focus predictably and SR reads concise label.
3 manual: test with Color Oracle or simulating deuteranopia + VoiceOver/NVDA to ensure patterns + color are distinguishable.
Lina: copy/UX note: legend wording should be short and explicit: "High (dark blue, crosshatch)" rather than just "High". Also add alt text for exported PNGs.
Duncan: please scope as a small ticket and aim for the next minor release. product supports pattern toggle behind a feature flag if needed.
Omar: i'll prototype patterns + legend changes and drop screenshots in the ticket. PR will include accessibility unit tests and a short e2e keyboard test.
Priya: awesome. a11y-bot, can you add this to the board?
a11y-bot: created card "Heatmap: colorblind patterns, accessible legend & keyboard cell nav" on board `a11y-tasks` with priority `medium` and linked prototype task.
Lina: thanks team  small visual tweak should help many users. will follow up after prototype. :seedling:
